question: Personally, instead of elegant fighters like Reinhard and Julius, I prefer cool fighters like Ricardo and Wilhelm; which do you prefer, Mr. Nagatsuki? I’d be very happy if your response included which is easier to write.
answer: All four of those have characters that are easy to write for, so there’s no distinction. Personally, I like polished silver, I guess? (note: polished silver seems to have several different connotations; the one about ‘men in their prime being manly in their own way’ may apply here.)
